//: Generic: where finished videos are published. No app or location is named here, nor in a variable name.
Each destination kind is read from its own .env variable; leave one unset to skip it. `match` finds
the folder or channel in the value (its first group). pipeline/publish.mjs uploads to every one set,
only for a video whose state is done (or accepted) and only with the user's final approval (--approved).

google-drive-folder.upload: Drive API v3 resumable upload into the folder, as the signed-in user (GOOGLE_OAUTH_* in .env)

youtube-channel.upload: YouTube Data API v3 resumable videos.insert with full metadata, then thumbnails.set, as the channel the user signed in as (YOUTUBE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN in .env); refused unless that channel is the configured one
